# Paycheck Math

> Free salary, hourly and take-home pay calculators for the United States, built on 2026 federal brackets and state income tax rules.

## Core pages
- https://pay.rerivo.com/paycheck-calculator/ — take-home pay by state
- https://pay.rerivo.com/salary-to-hourly/ — salary to hourly conversion
- https://pay.rerivo.com/hourly-to-salary/ — hourly to salary conversion
- https://pay.rerivo.com/after-taxes/ — salary after tax
- https://pay.rerivo.com/methodology/ — every rate and its source

## Facts
- Federal standard deduction 2026: $16,100 single, $32,200 married.
- FICA: Social Security 6.2% up to $184,500, Medicare 1.5%.
- Pages: 1085.
